maddeler.e:
اشرأببت (form IVq)
# اِشْرَأْبَبْتُ (išraʔbabtu) /iʃ.raʔ.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# اِشْرَأْبَبْتَ (išraʔbabta) /iʃ.raʔ.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
# اِشْرَأْبَبْتِ (išraʔbabti) /iʃ.raʔ.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِشْرَأَبَّ (išraʔabba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
